guard.forbiddenText: This area is restricted to Sword Brazil administrators.

overview.text: Choose what to edit. Every published change is visible immediately, with date and author.
overview.days: Restrictions for each BAX and BAL day.
overview.metas: Meta teams and reserves per day, BAL free mode and BAI.
overview.users: Members and administrators: accounts, roles, passwords and removing who left the alliance.
overview.rotations: Character rotations (damage dealers), per uniform, with a description and video.

days.title: Day restrictions
days.subtitle: Set each day's restriction. Different criteria are combined with "AND".
days.help: Pick one value per attribute. Leave "Any" to not restrict that attribute. BAI days (3, 10, 17, 24) are not listed.

season.title: Current season
season.help: Pair of effects that stuns the boss this season (28 days): the first in BAX, the second in BAL. Applies to every day of the mode; change it when the season changes.

metas.title: Meta teams
metas.label: Label (e.g. alternative without uniform X)
metas.ctpsHelp: CTP 1 and CTP 2 belong to the character and apply to all of their teams. For each day, pick which one the team uses.
metas.legacyCtp: This team still uses {{ctp}} for this day only. Pick CTP 1 or 2 to unify.
metas.deleteConfirm: Delete this team? This cannot be undone.
metas.help: Only active agents that meet the day restriction are listed. Marking as primary unmarks the previous one.
metas.boardHint: The whole cycle on one screen: edit, add or delete teams right on the day.
metas.reservesHint: Extra characters for the suggestion when players lack the Meta and Alternative ones. Order used: Meta → Alternatives → reserves.
metas.strikerHelp: Support unlocked at Transcendence 4: joins the fight and uses a single skill for extra damage.

order.title: Alternatives order
order.help: The main Meta always comes first. Move the alternatives or use a ready-made order, then save.

freeSync.label: Unrestricted days always the same (per mode)
freeSync.on: On: changing the teams or reserves of an unrestricted day copies everything to the others of the same mode (BAX only to BAX, BAL only to BAL), replacing what they have.
freeSync.off: Off: each unrestricted day has its own teams.
freeSync.dialog: Synced free day: saving makes the other unrestricted days of this mode the same as this one.

catalog.title: Agent catalog
catalog.name: Official name
catalog.uploadHint: PNG, WebP or JPEG, up to 2 MB.
catalog.deactivateHint: Deactivating keeps the agent in old teams, marked as unavailable.
catalog.help: Names must match the game. Use kebab-case slugs (e.g. scarlet-witch).
catalog.tooBig: The image must be up to 2 MB.
catalog.badType: Use a PNG, WebP or JPEG image.
catalog.slugAuto: Generated from the name; edit only if needed.
catalog.uniformsHint: Each uniform has its own attributes (gender, side, species and attack): day restrictions are checked against the uniform used. A new uniform starts with the first uniform's attributes.
catalog.effects: Boss effects (stuns in that effect's season)
catalog.metaStrikerHelp: Only tagged uniforms can be picked as the Damage Dealers' Striker (Metas and players' teams).
catalog.nameEnHint: Shown to people using the site in English or Spanish. Empty = shows the Portuguese name.

ctps.title: CTP catalog
ctps.help: Add, edit and delete CTPs. Deactivating hides the CTP from choices and keeps old teams; deleting removes it for good.
ctps.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}} for good? Meta teams and reserves recommending it will have no CTP. This can't be undone.

bai.title: BAI bosses
bai.subtitle: Single sequence, valid for every week.
bai.name: Name
bai.help: Bosses appear in this order on the BAI page.

users.title: Users and roles
users.lastAdmin: The last administrator cannot be demoted.
users.help: Only administrators create accounts and change passwords. Everyone signs in with a username and password. There must always be at least one administrator.
users.usernameHint: Used to sign in. E.g. the in-game nick (3 to 30 letters, digits, space, dot, hyphen or underscore). Case doesn't matter.
users.resetHelp: Set a new password and hand it to the person. The old password stops working right away.
users.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}'s account? Their roster, teams and scores go with it, and their open session ends. This can't be undone.
users.duplicateHint: Repeats another account's username or nickname (spelled differently). Delete the one that isn't used.
users.nicknameHint: In-game name. Can't repeat another account's (case, accents and punctuation don't count).

settings.title: Calendar settings
settings.anchor: Start of Day 1 (Brasília date and time)
settings.anchorHelp: A Thursday at 12 PM when a 28-day cycle started.
settings.help: Adjust the anchor if the "Current day" differs from the game.

rotations.subtitle: Each character's rotations: per uniform or for all, free text, with a description and video.
rotations.help: In Metas, mark the team's damage dealer; the character's rotations live here. Players tap the damage dealer's photo to see them.
rotations.editHelp: One rotation per situation or uniform. This order is the order players see.
rotations.sequencePlaceholder: E.g. 1 2c (3dc 4) 7 | 5 6 * — or write it your way
rotations.sequenceHint: Free text. The community notation (1–7, c, dc, qc, parentheses) shows as blocks; use | for the end of the rotation, / to start the next one and * to restart from the beginning.
rotations.legendFree: The notation is optional: write it however explains it best.
rotations.descriptionPlaceholder: When to use it, how long each delay is, what to watch for…
rotations.videoHint: YouTube link (video or Shorts; add ?t= to start at the right moment) or a .mp4/.webm file. It plays muted and looped; the video is not stored in the system.
rotations.english: In English (optional; Spanish uses the same)
rotations.seasonVideosHelp: The rotation is the same in every season; only the video changes. Leave it empty to use the mode video.

scoring.title: Modes where they score (Damage Dealer)
scoring.detected: Found in the Meta teams: {{modes}}. A video field shows up for each mode.
scoring.none: Not a Damage Dealer in any Meta team yet. Turn automatic off to pick the modes.
scoring.manual: Pick the modes: a demo video field shows up for each one.
